free_company_equivalents.description: Non-SP company-equivalents any division or brigade may attach on top of the maximum (chart modification)

turns.description: Game turns the row applies to, when the chart splits a parent type by date

max_units.description: Full-strength battalion-equivalent units (a company counts as one unit only where the chart says 'Company')

unit_kind.description: What the counted units must be, when the chart names a kind

alternatives.description: Where the chart offers 'N brigades and M units or K units', each option; max_units then holds the largest unit count

restrictions.description: Caps by type within the maximum: tank / infantry / recce / gun -> at most this many (0 = none allowed). 'infantry' excludes machine-gun and heavy-weapons units (chart key)

restriction_mode.description: For rows like '1 Infantry and/or 1 Tank': 'each' = one of each may be attached; 'combined' = one infantry OR one tank
